info.title: Determinize
info.description: Command line tool that rewrites PDF and System.IO.Packaging files (nupkg, docx, xlsx, pptx) so the same source always produces byte-identical output. Helpful for testing, build reproducibility, security verification, and ensuring output integrity across different build environments.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Rewrites PDF and System.IO.Packaging files (nupkg, docx, xlsx, pptx) so the same source always produces byte-identical output.

options.name: --target
options.description: Write results here instead of modifying the input in place. An output file path when the input is a file, otherwise a directory mirroring the input tree.

options.name: --pattern
options.description: Search patterns applied when the input is a directory. Defaults to every known PDF and package extension. Default: <*.pdf>, <*.nupkg>, <*.snupkg>, <*.vsix>, <*.docx>, <*.docm>, <*.dotx>, <*.xlsx>, <*.xlsm>, <*.xltx>, <*.pptx>, <*.pptm>, <*.potx>.

options.name: --recursive
options.description: Recurse into subdirectories when the input is a directory. Default: <false>.

options.name: --check
options.description: Report which files are not already deterministic without writing anything. Exits with code 1 if any are found. Default: <false>.

options.name: --continue-on-error
options.description: Keep processing the remaining files after a failure, then exit with code 1. Default: <false>.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress per file and summary output. Errors are still written. Default: <false>.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: List what changed in each file, indented under it. Default: <false>.

options.name: --strip-embedded-fonts
options.description: Remove the embedded font programs from PDFs, leaving each font named but not embedded. For producers that embed the machine's installed fonts. Lossy: a viewer substitutes its own fonts. Default: <false>.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: File, or directory containing files, to determinize. Rewritten in place unless --target is used.
